summary: PD20-C3 FIX: `src/plugin/live/closed-tool-arguments.mjs` is a plain-JS helper the two byte-copied confined shell modules (`confined-terminal-tool.mjs`, placement 140; `confined-bash-tool.mjs`, placement 130) import with a relative specifier to enforce their CLOSED parameter schema at the tool-call boundary (an undeclared `run_in_background` is refused as BACKGROUND_NOT_SUPPORTED instead of being silently dropped). tsc never emits `.mjs`, so the helper must ride the dist mirror at its repo-relative layout: without this entry the installed face would fail when a Member's shell module is loaded (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) — at member setup, not at build time.
